description: Reusable production wizard templates. {{field}} tokens are filled from user inputs; an empty field becomes [insert ...] placeholder.

emperor.label: Main character / emperor
emperor.hint: Trajan, Nerva, a servant, a senator...

focus.label: What happens in this scene / task

continuity.label: Where the previous scene ended
continuity.hint: Describe the last action or sentence to continue

visual.label: Visual reference / appearance
visual.hint: e.g. use approved Nerva character design

mood.label: Mood and lighting
mood.hint: e.g. restrained tension, soft afternoon light

sources.label: Historical facts / source notes
sources.hint: e.g. Cassius Dio, Pliny, verified timeline

extra.label: Additional directions
extra.hint: Anything else to include or avoid

templates.title: Research the next episode
templates.description: Turn a historical figure or event into a sourced, character-led episode concept.

templates.title: Create the episode outline
templates.description: Plan one continuous story and split it into practical recording segments.

templates.title: Generate narration for a section
templates.description: Create the next ElevenLabs-ready narration segment using existing research and continuity.

templates.title: Continue existing dialogue seamlessly
templates.description: Preserve tone and action when continuing a narration already in progress.

templates.title: Historical fact-check & continuity review
templates.description: Separate verified events from reconstruction and detect errors before approving narration.

templates.title: Create a single scene illustration
templates.description: One atmospheric, historically accurate painterly image with recurring-character consistency.

templates.title: Plan images from an existing script
templates.description: Create a coded shot list and consistent prompts for a section of narration.

templates.title: Animate an existing artwork subtly
templates.description: Generate image-to-video instructions without losing the illustration's painterly style.

templates.title: Prepare YouTube episode materials
templates.description: Generate title options, description, credits and source notes once an episode is ready.
